author: Akaimanto
quote: 13 years of development, only to run at 30 fps (absurd). It should be running at a rock-solid 60 fps, at the very least. The game uses PSSR upscaling technology to reach 4K—meaning it’s all artificial. Buying a PS5 Pro for this is truly disheartening. But what’s worse is realizing that the GTA franchise hasn’t just failed to escape the agendas pushed by repulsive movements—movements centered on identity politics that, deep down, HATE men—but the game also forces me to participate in scenarios involving horrific and humiliating sexual fetishes. Jason is the classic modern "beta"—the type who plays the role of "provider" and, worst of all, a "beta" with a *cuckold* fetish. I’m actually surprised he hasn’t bent over to take it up the ass, literally! Not to mention the various bugs and FPS drops—from 30 down to 20. It’s a shame! Honestly, you can’t even call this "GTA" anymore.
